Lose when unable to draw two Player cards after actions, not merely when deck becomes empty.

Lose at eighth outbreak/last outbreak-track space.
Lose immediately when cannot place cubes actually needed of required color during epidemic, outbreak or infection.

grades.observed_answer: Players win immediately when cures for all 4 diseases are discovered; eradication and a clear board are not required. They lose if the Outbreaks marker reaches its last space (8th outbreak), if they cannot place the required disease cubes of a needed color (during Epidemics, outbreaks, or infections), or if a player cannot draw 2 Player cards after actions. Insufficient cube supply causes an immediate loss when the required placement is attempted.
